decision: Grok design as base; graft gc stable age gauge; reject async persist and abandon-as-caught-up
why: Local 10k proof with scoped claim; Append is the ack; retirement needs tree coverage

decision: GCWithPins plus Stable; floor missing client counts as zero
why: Delegate treated a missing floor client as no limit, which collects tombstones deleted after the restore floor
evidence: TestStableFloorMissingClientKeepsLaterDelete fails under the delegate rule; pin-ignore mutation fails pin tests

decision: Helm chart and manual Argo app; one SERVICE-arg Dockerfile replaces per-service copies; make images
why: Chart referenced five images with no build; the two existing Dockerfiles differed only in name and port; migrations are embedded
evidence: make helm-check 40/40 valid both renders; deploy env test fails without INTERNAL_TOKEN; make images builds 7 images; hub image starts and checks env

decision: Log reads and policy wait off the hub loop; loop delivers missed ops then buffered live frames; policy note is a close-broadcast
why: Delegate polled every 5ms because a 1-slot note wakes only one of the loop and join waiters; broadcast removes the poll and the lost wakeup
evidence: TestReadDoesNotBlockApply and TestMissedOpsPrecedeLiveOps fail under their mutations; TestNotePolicyWakesEveryWaiter fails with a 1-slot note
result: full race suite green in isolation

decision: Metrics on all seven processes via injected collectors; Prometheus, Grafana, full compose; stack tests set METRICS_ADDR empty; branch e2e steps off seq%100 instead of failing
why: First delegate stalled mid-edit with Docker hung; second finished. Default metrics port collided across test processes. Branch test failed when head-7 hit a multiple of 100
evidence: Mutations: drop hub metric, fake panel metric both fail; 7 /metrics 200 and 7 Prometheus targets up; 36 packages plus fixed e2e green in isolation

decision: replica_reports with monotonic upsert under row lock; documents.vector in the append transaction; internal ReportVector/ListReports/ReleaseReplica
why: Design data shapes; FOR UPDATE makes the backwards check atomic; backfill is ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING so restarts never lower a report
evidence: Mutations: accept backwards report, skip delete clocks both fail; vector matches crdt replay on 4 seeds; 37 packages green in isolation

decision: AnchorPins and RestoreFloor internal RPCs; Restore and Branch refuse versions past RESTORE_HORIZON; threads store fork_root
why: Delegate's AnchorPins scanned every thread plus one ForkRoot RPC per home on every GC pass; ForkDocument is Internal-only so the Branch check covers user forks
evidence: Mutations: drop resolved threads, skip Branch horizon, drop fork_root WHERE all fail; full suite green in isolation before the fix, comment/e2e/stack green after

decision: Hub stamps replica vector reports after the group persists, clipped to doc.Vector, sent off-loop; clients report on join, on resume, and every 30s, never per ack; a fill with no progress re-arms the gap when the cursor moved
why: Per-ack reports split group commits and cost 40x echo latency (p50 2.8s vs 70ms); overlapping reads were being counted as fill failures and fail-stopped the hub
evidence: load 1 hub p50 15ms p99 81ms, 3 hubs p50 133ms p99 652ms (baseline p50 70ms / 2.1s); mutations dropping clipVector, making sendReport synchronous, re-adding per-ack report each fail a test
result: kept; full race suite green in isolated worktree

decision: GC worker in document-service builds live snapshot rows (kind=live, one per doc); Stable/Input in internal/gc over crdt.Stable; one retirement predicate (ReportRetired); hub swaps a built doc only when caught up, gap-free, no append above delivered, one build in flight
why: Delegate added env-var mutation switches to production code (COLLAB_GC_*, COLLAB_HUB_SWAP_*) and its pin test cleared the switch it claimed to test; removed them and mutate by editing code. Unbounded rebuilds on every fill would load the doc repeatedly on a busy hub
evidence: mutations: pins nil fails TestGCWorkerPinnedLeafSurvives; floor skipped fails TestStableHonorsFloor; no pending-append check fails live swap test; isolated race suite green; helm-check green

decision: Lapse decided in document-service (ClaimReplicaResponse.lapsed); lapsed join gets DocumentSync resync=true, no MissedOps; resync stays pending until the client's first VectorReport (FIFO socket); retirement = lapsed AND (home archived OR every unarchived tree doc covers the replica's own clock); version-service reports before plan and after append, the latter read via h.do inside drive
why: Delegate cleared resync at attach so a client ignoring resync could resend stale ops on the same socket; its post-append report re-entered withDoc inside drive and recursed on its own pending mutation (restore/merge hung, misreported as env); its worker never applied the sibling retirement rule; three stack tests were missing
evidence: e2e restore/merge/encrypted/system-replica green after fix; mutations: clear-on-attach fails TestResyncStaysPendingUntilClientReports, retired:=false fails branch GC test, pins nil fails horizon test, MissedOps for lapsed fails resume test; isolated race suite green

decision: Commit TestTenThousand (loadproof tag) and make load-proof unchanged: 500 docs x 20 conns, 2 hubs, HdrHistogram, p99 < 50ms asserted; the claim is refuted on this laptop as of this commit
why: Threshold and samples kept per design; a red run refutes. Stall traced with experiments: hub append is ~all of apply; periodic client reports are not the cause (1h interval: p99 114ms); per-doc PolicyDump every 500ms for 500 docs (~1000 RPC/s into permission-service and Postgres) drives append tail (1.5s period: appends >50ms 3/1941) but median append stays ~21ms vs 5.8ms p99 idle probe
evidence: runs: echo p99 62/71/86ms; reports off 114ms; policy 1.5s 66ms; OrbStack VM ~250% CPU during run; idle append probe p99 5.8ms
result: refuted; follow-up: batch PolicyDump per hub, profile document-service append

decision: Keep PolicyDumpBatch: one registry-level poll per hub process per 500ms (was one RPC per open document), woken immediately when a hub opens; pprof on every metrics server. Load-proof claim stays refuted on this laptop
why: Batching cuts ~1000 permission RPC/s to ~4 and is a real cost reduction, but with the test unchanged p99 is 62/75ms (baseline 62-86ms). Without the open-hub wake, first joins waited a poll period (dial 17s to 54s). Delegate's in-test pprof ran go tool pprof at window start and moved cohortStart; reverted. Postgres sampling under load: commits wait on WALWrite/WalSync; synchronous_commit=off (diagnostic, restored) cut mean append 22 to 17ms and p99 to 53ms; a 30s settle pause after dial did not help (80ms)
evidence: isolated race suite green; batch mutation fails TestPolicyDumpBatch; dial 15s with wake; load-proof runs 62/75ms
result: kept; claim refuted on this laptop (Docker VM Postgres commit path)

decision: System report insert-only on claim; GC env only on services that read it; operations count asserted after GC; Postgres PGDATA subdirectory
why: Re-claim overwrote the system floor mid-restore; Helm gave every service GC vars; no document-service test proved GC keeps the log; PVC root with lost+found blocks initdb
evidence: Mutations: overwrite-on-conflict, renamed GC_INTERVAL, DELETE in UpsertLiveSnapshot all fail their tests; isolated race suite EXIT=0; helm-check 40/40

decision: Tree-wide restore floor; empty report on every client claim; claim decides lapse in its tx, revives released replicas, honours resync_pending; retirement uses home vector; server clamps reports; resumed restore rechecks horizon; racy resync test rewritten through Session
why: Auto review found GC could collect nodes a branch, an unreported client, an interrupted resync, or a released device still needed; design requires tree floor, zero vector for no report, server clamp
evidence: Each guarantee failed under its mutation (delegates' list plus my reruns of resync guard and horizon test); resync test 40/40 under -race; isolated race suite EXIT=0

decision: GC stack tests age history and assert the live row; branch test protected only by B's report; hub swap tested end to end; GCWithPins test under pkg/crdt
why: Auto review showed these tests passed with GC doing nothing because the floor stayed at genesis
evidence: Each test failed under a matching production mutation (lapse, retirement, live-row load, swap, pin eligibility); isolated race suite EXIT=0

decision: Overlapping policy polls stamped by send time; report slots freed after leave; live rebuild guarded by tried vector and retry time; GC gauges aggregated per pass; load test counts hub sockets; branch per-node GC rule declined
why: Low review items: one slow batch fail-stopped all docs, unbounded slot map, rebuild loop on busy docs, last-doc gauges, constant connection print. Reports already zero out post-fork clients tree-wide, so a per-node rule needs a CRDT redesign with merge-race analysis
evidence: 7 hub mutations and 4 obs mutations each failed their tests (gauge max rerun by me); isolated race suite EXIT=0

decision: Load proof against native Postgres 17 (Homebrew, port 55433) instead of Docker
why: Docker runs failed at 53-114ms with commits waiting on WAL flush; isolate the database from Docker's VM
evidence: 4 runs at 10000 connections: 1 pass unlogged, echo p99 42.5ms pass, 161.7ms fail, 56.5ms fail; only checkpoints were forced at database creation, outside the window
result: partially met: target reachable with native Postgres, not reliable with load generator and services on one laptop
